NAM.note: A Paratus Data Hall 2 expansion is named but the document does not say the facility rents to others.

facts.fact: Paratus Namibia says it is the landing partner for the Equiano submarine cable in Namibia, also has access to WACS, and runs its own Trans-Kalahari fibre route from Windhoek to Johannesburg as another route out of the country.

NAM.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire is stated.
